description: Phase 4 end-to-end Distributed Trace dashboard. Per DOC-OBS-005 (05-tracing-design.md) §6.1 the on-call landing page after an alert: see a request's full span tree across the 18 crates, jump to its logs and metrics, and quantify the slow-trace tail. TraceQL queries are routed through the Tempo datasource provisioned in grafana/provisioning/datasources/datasources.yml.
title: Trace Overview (40-01)

panels.title: Recent traces (last 1h)
panels.description: List of the most recent traces, filtered by service. Click any row to open the full span tree. Powered by the Tempo `traces` panel (Grafana 10.4+).

panels.title: Service topology (last 1h)
panels.description: Service map built from trace edges. Edge weight = number of traces. Highlights the dominant inter-service call paths; useful for spotting n+1 patterns or accidental fan-out.

panels.title: Trace count by service (1h)
panels.description: Total trace count per service over the last hour, read via Tempo's metrics generator. Use to spot services that have stopped emitting spans (a flat line at 0) versus hot services.

panels.title: p99 trace duration by service (5m)
panels.description: Server-side p99 trace duration per service. Tail-sampled via the OTel Collector (errors + slow-traces + 10% probabilistic) so the curve is the production experience, not the raw client timings.
